'''Min-Reva''' was a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}} As "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]" takes place after the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]], and Malcom states it has been 40 years since the start of the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3681 BBY]], the story must thus take place in 3640 BBY.</ref> Min-Reva was assigned to [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]]'s [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] and served with [[Republic Special Forces Division|SpecForce]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] during a [[Battle of Kalandis Seven|battle]] on [[Kalandis Seven]], a desolate [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. During the course of the battle, the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was tasked with the destruction of the [[Kalandis Seven's spaceport|local Imperial-controlled spaceport]]. On the way to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], the squad was attacked, though only one soldier was badly wounded, [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Amden vor Keioidian]]. Three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, Min-Reva and the squad finally reached the spaceport and started planting [[targeting beacon]]s, which would allow Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to destroy the spaceport regardless of the [[Water/Legends|fog]]. Shortly after the squad finished planting the last of the beacons, the spaceport was destroyed by Republic starfighters.<ref name="TLBoCJM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Min-Reva first appeared, albeit voice only, in [[Alexander Freed]]'s short story "[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]," which was published in the [[Star Wars Insider 137|137th issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="TLBoCJM" /> on [[October 23]], [[2012]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/137|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #137}}</ref>
